```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(anndata)
```

```{r paths}
dracc_dir = Sys.getenv("DRACC_PROCESSED_DIR")
corrected_de_xm_dir = Sys.getenv("DRACC_DE_XM_DIR")
stage_order = c("ES", "DE", "DE_XM", "PP1", "PP2", "S5_1", "S5_2", "S6_1", "S6_2")

feature_paths = setNames(
  ifelse(
    stage_order == "DE_XM",
    file.path(corrected_de_xm_dir, "features", "gene", "features.h5ad"),
    file.path(dracc_dir, paste0("30_KO_", stage_order), "features", "gene", "features.h5ad")
  ),
  stage_order
)

missing_paths = feature_paths[!file.exists(feature_paths)]
if (length(missing_paths) > 0) {
  stop("Missing gene feature files:\n", paste(missing_paths, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

## Read Gene H5AD Files

Read one `features/gene/features.h5ad` per stage and keep the AnnData objects
as a named list.

```{r read-h5ad}
gene_features = lapply(feature_paths, \(path) anndata::read_h5ad(path, backed = "r"))
```

## AnnData Objects

Print each stage-level AnnData object.

```{r print-h5ad}
for (stage_id in names(gene_features)) {
  cat("\n\n", stage_id, "\n", sep = "")
  print(gene_features[[stage_id]])
}
```

## `obs` And `var` Heads

Print the first two rows of `obs` and `var` for each stage.

```{r print-heads, results='asis'}
for (stage_id in names(gene_features)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", stage_id, " obs\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(head(as.data.frame(gene_features[[stage_id]]$obs, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), 2L)))

  cat("\n\n### ", stage_id, " var\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(head(as.data.frame(gene_features[[stage_id]]$var, stringsAsFactors = FALSE), 2L)))
}
```
